title: Refuse outgoing task-sync keys with unchanged Git bytes before retaining preparation
outcome: An outgoing preparation refuses a declared task key that cannot produce a raw Git change, while allowing a real byte change even if the decoded task value is equal.
acceptance: An outgoing request with an unchanged task path is refused before preparation or custody is retained, naming that key and the remedy.
The admission check compares actual Git bytes at the selected basis and accepts a genuine raw reformat whose decoded document is unchanged.
An executable regression covers unchanged and reformatted task paths through the normal preparation and commit-basis owners.
